name: Space heater
note: Pulls the most of anything in the house. Give it its own wall outlet.

name: Shop vac
note: Label usually says 12-13 A. Short bursts, but a big starting pull.

name: Battery maintainer (trickle charger)
note: About 0.75-1.5 A on the battery side, but only about 0.2-0.4 A from the wall. Bigger 10 A chargers pull much more.

name: Heated pet bed
note: Small ones use 4-6 W; outdoor pads up to about 40-60 W.

name: LED Christmas lights (100-bulb string)
note: Check the tag for how many strings can be connected end to end.
